title: Ligue se Grupo
description: grupoligue-se.pt Ligue-se Grupo is a Portuguese IT and business-services group founded in 2009 in Funchal, Madeira (born from the merger of accounting firm Contatlântico and IT company Enterformatic). It runs several businesses: Chip7 retail computer stores (Madeira + Lisbon) selling PCs, laptops and accessories with repair services; GoClick, a B2B IT arm handling infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud/Microsoft 365, ERP software (Sage, PHC, ZoneSoft) and hotel-tech solutions; and Ligue.Gest, offering accounting, payroll and tax consulting. Led by CEO Ivo Herculano Caires and CFO Élia Caires, it targets SMEs and private clients across Madeira and mainland Portugal. In short: one group covering everything from hardware sales and repairs to IT management and bookkeeping.
